[1/4] Baseline and select a lossless structural token-generation optimization

impact_assessment.benefits: Higher tokens/s with exact output parity and cross-model evidence
impact_assessment.mitigation: Measure first; failing-first differential tests; interleaved A/B on at least two models or model-shaped kernels; revert and log any non-win
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve greedy/sampled semantics and kernel parity; dependency: stdlib/C++20 only; concurrency: thread-pool synchronization; state: no persisted format change
impact_assessment.why: Decode is bandwidth-bound and prior ALU/scheduling/build variants are exhausted; the next gain must remove work or weight traffic without changing generated tokens

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implement confidence-adaptive greedy draft verification with exact-output regression tests

impact_assessment.benefits: Lower speculative decode cost without changing verifier arithmetic or accepted output
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure drafter tests first; preserve six-row fused path; byte-identical ids across Q8_0/Q4_K_M and models; interleaved A/B; revert if no cross-model win
impact_assessment.risks: contract: variable verifier row count and fused-state invariants; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged pools; state: no persisted format change
impact_assessment.why: Fixed six-row verification wastes batched work on weak one/two-token matches; real trace replay predicts 53% and 67% fewer verifier rows on two natural prompts

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Baseline and candidate triage; [2/4] implement conservative one-token adaptive verification; [3/4] interleaved cross-model A/B plus periodic/penalty controls; [4/4] record ADR, measurements, README, run gates and deliver

impact_assessment.benefits: Fewer verifier rows and higher decode t/s with byte-identical ids
impact_assessment.mitigation: Two-token/bigram/gapped/periodic drafts stay six rows; short batches never enter fused state; revert any control regression
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional verifier width and spec output; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: no persisted format change
impact_assessment.why: Aggressive two-token adaptation broke periodic fusion; only isolated one-token exact matches may shorten without disturbing long accepted chains
